Package com.saicone.types

Class TypeWrapper<A,B>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.types.TypeWrapper<A,B>
Type Parameters:
A - the base type of object, you can get it by unwrap(Object) the type B.
B - the type of object that wrap(Object) type A, in other words, to show A as B.
public abstract class TypeWrapper<A,B> extends Object
Abstract class to apply lazy conversions between type of objects.
